findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Requests that arrive while the cache is empty all pass the initial read-lock check before the first request publishes a value. They then serialize on this write lock, but every waiter unconditionally rereads and reparses the manifest instead of using the value populated by the first request. A burst of startup requests therefore causes O(n) sequential filesystem reads/parses and delays each request. After acquiring the write lock, check `cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil` again and return the cached value before performing I/O.
